message: In the twin under-deck Tuned Mass Damper (TMD, mass on spring with damper tuned to bridge mode) retrofit concept, the crowd comfort acceptance has Comfort Level (CL, Setra comfort grade) target question raised by Manager, thank you Manager. To check it I used the two-degree-of-freedom response simulation (the two-degree-of-freedom response simulation (E6)) against the comfort target assumption (the comfort target assumption (C1)). I found reduction from 17.50 metres per second squared to 0.74 metres per second squared with 9.44 percent effective damping, reaching CL2 below 1.0 metre per second squared, according to Setra, 2006. I propose accepting CL2 as comfortable retrofit outcome for this lively baseline. My position: ready because damping increase and acceleration reduction to comfortable level are demonstrated. In the concealed mounting concept, the install and maintenance method has closure and visibility risk, thank you Retrofit Integration Architect. To check it I used the concealed mounting detail sketch (the concealed mounting detail sketch (E9)) with the Den Hartog optimum result (the Den Hartog optimum result (E3)) and the phased install plan (the phased install plan (C4)). I found zero hardware above deck level with paired 250 kilogram units tuned to 1.81 hertz installable from mobile scaffold below the soffit with no deck closure, according to Den Hartog, 1947. I propose night-time clamp-beam install with six-monthly soffit-hatch inspection and annual re-tuning. My position: ready because invisible-from-deck and maintainable build is shown.
